# Dry Powder

> Open, risk-first perpetuals on Arc Testnet (chain 5042002, USDC gas), built for people and AI agents. One USDC
> vault is the counterparty to every trade at the oracle price. Up to 1000x; above 100x trades fill only through
> keeper orders. You can never lose more than margin plus fees.

## Rules
- Leverage 1x to the market maximum: BTC-USD and ETH-USD 1000x; SOL-USD 500x; EUR-USD, XAU-USD and the dated BTC future 250x; JPY-USD and ETH-BTC 100x.
- Above 100x: open with PerpEngine.createLimitOrder (marketable trigger = market order), close with setTriggerOrder(marketId, 3, worstPrice, size) (size 0 = all). openPosition/closePosition revert with HighLeverageNeedsOrder.
- Liquidation when losses plus funding reach 90% of margin (a 0.09% move at 1000x). Profit capped at 10x margin. Fees: 5 bp of size plus a skew surcharge, each side capped at 10% of margin.
- Units: USDC 6 decimals; prices 18 decimals. One position per market per trader: an open on the same side adds to it, the other side reverts PositionExists.
- Manage: closePosition(marketId, size, acceptablePrice, priceUpdate) closes all or part; setTriggerOrder(marketId, 1|2, price, size) for sized take-profit/stop-loss; addMargin(marketId, amount) (not while in profit); LimitParams.stopEntry = true for breakout entries; AgentAccount.multicall for atomic batches.
- Add-ons for agent accounts (approve each as an agent; the keeper pokes them): TrailingStops.setTrail(account, marketId, distanceBps, size, activation) for a stop that only tightens; TwapOrders.setTwap(account, marketId, isLong, sliceMargin, sliceSize, slices, interval, maxSlippageBps) for 2-100 slices 30 s to 1 day apart.
- Collateral on testnet is tUSDC (anyone may mint up to 1,000,000 per call); gas is native USDC from https://faucet.circle.com.

## Addresses
- [Live deployment JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/main/deployments/arc-testnet.json): engine, lens, vault, token, usdc, agentFactory, trailingStops, twapOrders, markets.
- RPC: https://rpc.testnet.arc.io (fallbacks: rpc.quicknode.testnet.arc.io, rpc.drpc.testnet.arc.io, rpc.blockdaemon.testnet.arc.io). Explorer: https://explorer.testnet.arc.io

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how agents trade, which orders to use, the worst-case check before every trade.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/tree/main/sdk): DryPowder.connect, quote (worst case first), open, close (all or part), setStops, addMargin, scale, closeAll, cancelAll, agent accounts, pure risk maths.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/tree/main/mcp): tools dp_markets, dp_quote, dp_open, dp_limit, dp_close, dp_set_tpsl, dp_add_margin, dp_cancel, dp_account, dp_faucet.
- [Examples](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/tree/main/examples): quickstart, risk-capped agent, swarm.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
- [Venue stats (JSON, every 5 minutes)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xAndersen/dry-powder/status/status/stats.json): per-trader and per-market totals.
